1.title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for Ukraine talks
1.summary: Footage shows Vladimir Putin greeting Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, before saying the current situation "is not so easy".

2.title: Robin Morgan, Voice of Radical Feminism, Dies at 85
2.summary: She edited the landmark 1970 anthology “Sisterhood Is Powerful,” led Ms. magazine and helped build the institutions of the modern feminist movement.

3.title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
3.summary: Iran's state media reported that Tehran has launched retaliatory attacks against three US-affiliated vessels; the US is yet to comment.

5.title: TV presenter among 11 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
5.summary: Sarah Khalifa is best known for her TV programme Mission Impossible which dealt with crime issues.

6.title: U.S. Strikes Three Iranian ‘Shadow Network’ Oil Tankers, Military Says
6.summary: The U.S. military said it retaliated after Iran launched missiles at two warships. The strikes came days after the two sides exchanged some of their most intense fire in weeks.
